title: Hinomori Shiho — How Things Develop From Here〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Thanks to all of Ichika's hard work, our new song's unbelievably good.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This song might just be able to...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We've come up with an incredible song, so we have to put on the best performance possible.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (In order to do that, we'll need to...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning. I want to discuss our practice schedule from today onwards. Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to discuss that as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Mind taking a look at this?
It's a preliminary schedule based on all of our shifts for work and whatnot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it ended up becoming much tighter than usual...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If we want to have our new song ready in time... Okay, let's have a closer look...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, this is a lot tighter than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's with these blue circles?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, those are days when we won't be able to do full run-throughs because one of us has work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There are a few of those, but things could conceivably become a little easier if we decided to hold practice during some of these days.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I was hoping to hear from everyone about their individual schedules after school today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to laugh like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
But you seem really happy all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've become such a reliable person, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why would I lie about something like this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're always looking out for us and coming up with schedules that we can actually accomplish as a band...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's only possible if you clearly know what someone needs to work on and how much time they're going to require.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I usually try to compare our previous schedules and practices to what we're doing now on top of trying new things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So there's a lot of trial and error involved...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But your schedules are always a huge help, Honami. We wouldn't know what to do without them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Without a schedule, just practicing a lot doesn't mean we'll be ready in time for a show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Plus, if we believe that we won't be ready, we can always think of something to do for Hanano and her brother outside of putting on a show for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course, things won't always go as planned. Regardless, our goal's going to be to “put on the best performance possible.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In the end, it's just so much better having a schedule and knowing how we're progressing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really appreciate you saying that, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've received so much praise from you this morning that I can't help but think today's going to be a wonderful day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get that I'm pretty hard on all of you, but I do properly compliment you guys when I think you deserve it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means I should keep trying my best so you praise me like this every day.
